meta.title: Stop User Enumeration demo
meta.description: Try the common user-enumeration probes as a logged-out visitor and see them blocked.
meta.author: fullworks

steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Playground demo only: the front end (including REST) behaves as a logged-out
 * visitor, so the probes are blocked even though the demo is logged in to wp-admin.
 * Stop User Enumeration deliberately never blocks logged-in users.
 */
add_filter(
	'determine_current_user',
	function ( $user_id ) {
		if ( is_admin() || wp_doing_ajax() || ( isset( $GLOBALS['pagenow'] ) && 'wp-login.php' === $GLOBALS['pagenow'] ) ) {
			return $user_id;
		}
		return 0;
	},
	99
);
